target.title: A Discrimination Requirement for Structural Approaches to Cognitive-Capacity Individuation

mission: Attempt to make the strongest defensible Reject / Reject-and-Resubmit case against the M21 manuscript, rather than to maximize constructive sympathy.
constraints: Do not modify main.tex, supplement.tex, references.bib, corpus records, comparator results, CPCG results, replay results, or prior M10-M21 authorities.
Distinguish an objection that is fatal to the current argument from a limitation that merely lowers confidence.
Prefer objections that attack the paper on its own stated definitions and inferential commitments.
Do not prescribe new large-scale empirical work unless logically necessary.

external_comparators.work: Stegenga and Menon 2017 robustness and independent evidence
